Every failure on the vault's `/v1` interface answers an [RFC 7807](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807) problem document, served as `application/problem+json`:

```json
{
  "type": "https://bitrealm.io/vault/developer/reference/errors/username-taken",
  "title": "Username taken",
  "status": 409,
  "detail": "username already taken: alice",
  "request_id": "3f2b1c0e-8d4a-4b6e-9f21-5c7d8e9a0b1c"
}
```

`type` is the address of one of the pages below, and a client that needs to know what went wrong compares its last segment. `title` is fixed per type; `detail` is one sentence about this occurrence. A `validation-failed` problem lists `errors`, every rule the request broke, in place of `detail`. `request_id` repeats the response's `x-request-id` header, which the vault's log carries on every line the request produced.

A `500 Internal Server Error` has no page: its `type` is `about:blank`, and its detail is a fixed sentence, because the cause is in the vault's log and not something a client can act on.

| Type | Status | Title |
|---|---|---|
| [`validation-failed`](./validation-failed/) | `422 Unprocessable Entity` | Validation failed |
| [`missing-parameter`](./missing-parameter/) | `400 Bad Request` | Missing parameter |
| [`malformed-body`](./malformed-body/) | `400 Bad Request` | Malformed body |
| [`unsupported-media-type`](./unsupported-media-type/) | `415 Unsupported Media Type` | Unsupported media type |
| [`payload-too-large`](./payload-too-large/) | `413 Payload Too Large` | Payload too large |
| [`invalid-credentials`](./invalid-credentials/) | `401 Unauthorized` | Invalid credentials |
| [`authentication-required`](./authentication-required/) | `401 Unauthorized` | Authentication required |
| [`rate-limited`](./rate-limited/) | `429 Too Many Requests` | Rate limited |
| [`username-taken`](./username-taken/) | `409 Conflict` | Username taken |
| [`name-taken`](./name-taken/) | `409 Conflict` | Name taken |
| [`demo-account-protected`](./demo-account-protected/) | `403 Forbidden` | Demo account protected |
| [`not-the-owner`](./not-the-owner/) | `403 Forbidden` | Not the owner |
| [`insufficient-scope`](./insufficient-scope/) | `403 Forbidden` | Insufficient scope |
| [`account-disabled`](./account-disabled/) | `403 Forbidden` | Account disabled |
| [`search-query-invalid`](./search-query-invalid/) | `400 Bad Request` | Search query invalid |
| [`state-conflict`](./state-conflict/) | `409 Conflict` | State conflict |
| [`asset-upload-invalid`](./asset-upload-invalid/) | `400 Bad Request` | Asset upload invalid |
| [`not-found`](./not-found/) | `404 Not Found` | Not found |
| [`method-not-allowed`](./method-not-allowed/) | `405 Method Not Allowed` | Method not allowed |
| [`not-acceptable`](./not-acceptable/) | `406 Not Acceptable` | Not acceptable |
